title: Cactus
body:
Description

Cactus is a "wood" found on the island of Ferwater in the Oke Desert. It is green in color with a cactus like texture. The sanded wood is a whiteish light green color with no texture.

Sometimes, it could produce Pink Flowers that could be sold raw or processed into a Jar by the use of a Dye Machine.

Trivia

  • Cacti are one of the only "trees" that don't use the basic tree mesh for its appearance, just like its counterpart the Purple Cactus, Red Cactus and bamboo.
  • Generally, cacti are not a tree.
